_what: Per-library reference data for the three promoted stages: the truth panel a run is checked against, and the cross-plant panel a run is subtracted against. Read through experiments/stage_refs.py, which raises rather than defaults.
_why_a_file: A stage that resolves a sample-specific input from a built-in default runs happily against the wrong sample on any machine where that sample's file exists, and nothing in the output says so. Every value here was a literal inside a script or a shell template before it was a row in this file.
_folds_into: experiments/libraries.json when that lands (trim_r2, block, read paths). These keys are the stage-reference half of the same idea and the loader in stage_refs.py is the fold-in point; two files are the interim, not the design.
_entry_rules: A library with no entry is UnknownLibrary: the stage refuses to start. It never guesses a panel.
A library whose entry sets a panel to null is a MEASURED absence with a reason, and the stage records status skipped with that reason. null is not the same fact as missing.
Paths are repo-relative. A path that does not exist is a refusal at preflight, not a stage that quietly reports zero.

removal_shortlist_band._what: The coverage x identity cell the explained-fraction shortlist ships at, over the pile tier 1 removed.
removal_shortlist_band.the_measurement: The withheld genome's best protein hit covers 0.4624 of the contig at 66.5% identity, which lands in this cell: 69 contigs, 0.91% of the removed pile, and not one of the leak arm's 34 known contigs from the same water enters it.
removal_shortlist_band.why_that_is_said_here: The band was drawn where the one known positive sits, on a positive set of size one. It is an operating point with a provenance, not a validated threshold, and a stage that shipped it silently would be quoting a tuned cut as a property of the method. The whole joint table ships beside it so the band can be moved at output time (SPEC 13.3).
removal_shortlist_band.what_must_not_be_done_instead: Rank the removed pile by identity. Measured on the same pile: the withheld genome sits at the 93.46th percentile of removal identity, so an identity rule reaches 7,104 other contigs first. 'Flag the low-identity removals' is dead and measured.
removal_shortlist_band.ordering_within_the_cell_is_open: The candidate ranks 4th by bitscore inside its own cell at nucleotide level and 2nd at protein, so the defensible output is the cell with a count on it, never a flag and never the top row.

null_citations.shuffled_contigs_with_a_significant_hit: 0 of 22,110 (results/holdout_cascade/) and 0 of 11,361 on Berlin (results/crossplant/ shuffle arm, corrected null)
null_citations.why_it_is_a_citation_and_not_this_run_s_: This stage reads search output the cascade already wrote; it runs no search of its own, so it cannot produce a null. Pass --shuffled-evidence to supply one, or --without-null to record its absence by name.

SRR23973193.truth_panel_absent_because: No depositor-assembled genome set exists for this water: results/holdout_candidates/depth.tsv covers SRR23421542/43/44 only. This library's positive control is the spiked divergence ladder (--calibrate), not a truth panel, and a run of it reports the panel stage as skipped with this reason rather than scoring against another library's genomes.

SRR23702504.label: Yeongdok plant effluent, South Korea, collected 2020-09-11, RNA. The first library this repo runs production over without having measured anything on it first.
SRR23702504.truth_panel_absent_because: No depositor-assembled genome set exists for this water. results/holdout_candidates/depth.tsv covers SRR23421542/43/44 only, and scoring this library against those Russian genomes would report another water's ground truth as this one's. So recovery against truth is ABSENT for this sample, not zero, and the residue fraction it ships beside therefore travels without the recovery figure SPEC 4.3 requires of a path-settings comparison - which is a stated limit of running a new sample, not a result about it.
SRR23702504.positive_control_absent_because: Berlin's substitute for a panel is the spiked divergence ladder (--calibrate), and that stage needs a cross-sample reference assembly from the same works, which this run did not stage. This library therefore ran with no positive control of any kind: nothing in it has a distance fixed before the run.
SRR23702504.crossplant_panel_basis: The library is NOT a member of cp3 - results/crossplant/panel.tsv holds 536 rows and this accession is not one of them - so its query reads are not searched against its own library, which is the refusal crossplant_stage.py enforces and the one that would invent recurrence (54% false growth against a 6% swap control). The plant IS in the panel with 12 libraries, three of them influent from this same date (2020-09-11, YIF807/808/809), so the paired within-plant stratum the measurement needs exists and is same-plant-same-date-other-water: it separates water type from drift, which no other pairing in the panel does.

depositor_25._what: The depositors' own virus genomes from the same waters, deposited 2023-07-31, with each one's depth in a given run measured by mapping the reads back. The present/absent split is per run and comes out of the same table, so the false-join control is drawn from the same pool as the recovery panel and costs nothing.

operating_point.secondary_alignments: ON, and this is not the obvious setting: with --secondary=no each contig is credited to one genome only, so one member of every near-identical pair reads 0.00 breadth and a 499x genome looks like an assembly failure. Recovery at >=90% breadth read 9/25 instead of 20/25.

depositor_25.purity_is_against_the_group: Near-identical accessions are grouped before purity is measured, because OQ722323 is a 5,048 nt partial deposit 99.84% identical to the 9,467 nt OQ722327: per-accession purity reports a correct recovery as absorption into foreign sequence. The accession-level figure ships beside the group figure.
what_this_panel_cannot_test: Sub-3.8% lineage fusion. The panel is not a lineage mixture: it is 25 separate molecules, so it cannot see the fusion results/pair_ladder/ measures below ~3.8% divergence. It does contain at least six pairs above 99.4% identity, but at 99.9% identity a 200 nt alignment at >=95% cannot say which member a contig came from, so breadth cannot answer it either. That question needs variant-level attribution.

Anything at the depth where most of the residue sits. These 25 genomes are what the depositors could already assemble, at 0.4x to 700x; nothing in the panel sits at the median depth 1 of results/residue_census/, and no setting creates coverage that is not there.
Recovery on another water. One library, one sample, and the drift caveat applies: the same plant eight months apart moves rRNA from 38.0% to 67.1%.
depositor_25.reproduces: Against the two attributed contigs of results/holdout_cascade/ the scorer returns 3,990 nt covering 96.21% of OQ722337.1 at purity 1.0, and 6,383 nt covering 99.41% of OQ722330.1 - the published figures, from different code.

cp3._what: 530 other wastewater RNA libraries over five projects, 32 plants and four continents, each cut to exactly the same depth so a difference between plants is not a difference in library size.
cp3.both_points_travel: They disagree by a factor of four about the thing the measurement is for - at depth 1 the identified-versus-residue gap is 8.5 points at `most` and 42.0 at `any` - so neither ships alone.
cp3.witness_instrument: exact canonical 31-mer presence, the same instrument as results/recurrence/

subject_trim_r2_by_project._why: Berlin's SMARTer Pico mate 2 carries ~14 nt of non-template prefix (results/nontemplate_prefix/); no other kit in the panel has a measured prefix. The committed experiments/crossplant_userdata.sh carries this same rule as a literal and is deliberately not edited - that would change the provenance of a result nobody is re-running. It folds into this file the next time that pass runs.

staged_for_reuse.what_is_staged: the reduced query x subject bit matrices and the per-subject witness files of the runs already made, which is what a report reads
staged_for_reuse.what_is_NOT_staged: the 531 subject FASTQ subsets themselves. Each pass re-downloads them from SRA on the instance, which is the bulk of its wall time; staging them once would make later passes cheaper and has not been done, so a new sample's pass costs a fresh download.
staged_for_reuse.why_that_is_recorded_here: An absent staged copy is a cost, not a failure, and a stage that silently re-downloaded would hide it.

rules_that_travel_with_this_panel: Query reads must come from OUTSIDE the library searched. Own-library reads are abundant by construction: measured at 54% false growth against a 6% swap control, and queries are drawn from spots outside each library's own subject subset for exactly this reason.
The query library is never a panel member and never enters a union. SRR23973193 is absent from panel.tsv by construction.

Report PAIRED per plant, never pooled. Within-plant rates run 0.1530 to 0.9593, a six-fold spread, so a pooled within-minus-between difference compares plants instead of comparing within against between. The paired gap is +0.1432 (most1), positive in 32 of 32 plants.
Contig queries go in 90 nt windows, the same width as the read queries, so the instrument does not change between the two arms.
Read every saturation figure DOWN the depth column, not across the pile row: depth decides and the pile label almost nothing. A union is blind to anything present once, not to novelty.
cp3.what_this_panel_cannot_say: Absence here means no 31 exact bases shared with any panel library, which past roughly 10-15% divergence is not the same as having no relative there. One substitution destroys up to 31 of a 90 nt mate's 60 31-mers.
